req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json content type for all echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that all echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) must return application/json content type. I design: (1) positive EP tests for each endpoint verifying exact Content-Type header value and HTTP 200 status; (2) a negative test verifying that a wrong method returns 405 (not 2xx), confirming the endpoint is method-gated; (3) boundary tests checking the exact string 'application/json' is present (not a superset/subset), and that the response body is valid JSON with expected top-level keys. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 not >=200), exact content-type strings (not substring), and exact JSON key presence.

tests.name: test_get_returns_application_json_content_type
actions: Inspect Content-Type header and status code
expected: Response body is valid JSON with keys: url, args, headers, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

client = app.test_client()

def test_get_returns_application_json_content_type():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got: {ct}'
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'args' in body
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert 'origin' in body

test_get_returns_application_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_post_returns_application_json_content_type
actions: Inspect Content-Type header and status code
expected: Response body is valid JSON with keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

client = app.test_client()

def test_post_returns_application_json_content_type():
    r = client.post('/post', data=json.dumps({'key': 'value'}),
                    content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got: {ct}'
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files'):
        assert key in body, f'Missing key: {key}'

test_post_returns_application_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_content_type_exact_mime_type_not_text_html
actions: Send GET /get, POST /post, PUT /put, PATCH /patch, DELETE /delete
Assert Content-Type is exactly 'application/json' (with optional charset), NOT 'text/html' or 'text/plain'
expected: Content-Type starts with 'application/json' for all endpoints
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 boundary: distinguishing application/json from other MIME types
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

client = app.test_client()

def test_content_type_exact_mime_type_not_text_html():
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'{method} {path}: got {ct}'
        assert not ct.startswith('text/html'), f'{method} {path}: got text/html'
        assert not ct.startswith('text/plain'), f'{method} {path}: got text/plain'
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{method} {path}: status {r.status_code}'

test_content_type_exact_mime_type_not_text_html()

tests.name: test_get_response_body_is_parseable_json_with_exact_keys
actions: Send GET /get with query param foo=bar
Assert exact top-level keys match specification
expected: Response body parses as JSON without error
Top-level keys are exactly: url, args, headers, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

client = app.test_client()

def test_get_response_body_is_parseable_json_with_exact_keys():
    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    expected_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'origin'}
    assert set(body.keys()) == expected_keys, f'Keys mismatch: {set(body.keys())}'
    assert body['args'] == {'foo': 'bar'}, f"args mismatch: {body['args']}"

test_get_response_body_is_parseable_json_with_exact_keys()

expected: All five endpoints return Content-Type: application/json

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

client = app.test_client()

def test_all_echo_endpoints_return_200_and_json_content_type():
    cases = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in cases:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{method} {path} status={r.status_code}'
        ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'{method} {path} ct={ct}'
        body = json.loads(r.data)
        assert isinstance(body, dict), f'{method} {path} body not dict'

test_all_echo_endpoints_return_200_and_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_post_json_body_reflected_in_json_key
actions: Send POST /post with Content-Type application/json and body {"x": 1}
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

client = app.test_client()

def test_post_json_body_reflected_in_json_key():
    payload = json.dumps({'x': 1})
    r = client.post('/post', data=payload, content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Content-Type: {ct}'
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['json'] == {'x': 1}, f"json key mismatch: {body['json']}"

test_post_json_body_reflected_in_json_key()

tests.name: test_content_type_charset_utf8_in_get_response
actions: Optionally check charset is utf-8 if present
expected: If charset present, it is utf-8
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 boundary: charset portion of Content-Type must not override application/json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

client = app.test_client()

def test_content_type_charset_utf8_in_get_response():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct, f'application/json not in Content-Type: {ct}'
    if 'charset' in ct:
        assert 'utf-8' in ct.lower(), f'charset is not utf-8: {ct}'
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert isinstance(body, dict)

test_content_type_charset_utf8_in_get_response()
